result.title: m-Set Adversarial Bandits with Winner Feedback
result.summary: We show upper and lower bounds on the regret of $m$-set adversarial bandits for different utilities (winner reward or sum of rewards) and feedback models (winner index, winner reward, sum of rewards, and their combinations). By comparing to standard bounds for combinatorial and MNL bandits, our results reveal how subtle changes in the setting can have a dramatic impact on the learning rates. Our main technical contributions are the information-theoretic lower bounds on the regret. Experiments on synthetic data confirm our theoretical analyses.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文研究 m-set 对抗性 bandit 问题，针对不同效用（winner 奖励或奖励之和）与多种反馈模型（winner 索引、winner 奖励、奖励之和及其组合），给出遗憾的上界与下界，并用合成实验验证理论分析。
AI.relevance_reason: 反馈模型与遗憾下界的形式化可能为 LVR 的 LOOK/STOP 决策与视觉证据筛选提供评价工具，例如把「只看 winner 信息」类比为受限观测下的证据获取成本，但联系尚属推测，需核查其组合选择与反馈粒度是否可迁移。
